title: Knowledge Check 2: Lessons 6–10
description: Pooled check over Lessons 6–10 of the Agentic Ai series. Score 80% or higher to unlock the cert prep exam.

questions.question: Per the lesson “Choosing Models & Providers: Capability Tiers, Routing, and Fallbacks”, what is the central focus?
options: The biggest agent-ops mistake is picking one 'best' model and pointing everything at it. This lesson builds the three-tier capability model, the three jobs of a router, and the fallback chains that keep agents alive when providers fail.
A history of the technology and its vendors
A review of unrelated productivity tools
A summary of corporate policy rules
questions.explanation: The lesson is centered on: The biggest agent-ops mistake is picking one 'best' model and pointing everything at it. This lesson builds the three-tier capability model, the three jobs of a router, and the fallback chains that keep agents alive when providers fail.

questions.question: Per the lesson “Function-Calling Parity Across OpenAI, Azure, Anthropic, Gemini, and Local Models”, what is the central focus?
options: Every frontier provider exposes function calling, but none uses the same wire format.
A history of the technology and its vendors

questions.explanation: The lesson is centered on: Every frontier provider exposes function calling, but none uses the same wire format. This lesson maps the request and response shapes across OpenAI, Azure, Anthropic, and Gemini, then shows why local models (llama.cpp) are the parity wildcard and how one internal schema plus thin per-provider adapters keeps an agent portable.
